claim: Belief ids are namespaced as `namespace:local-id` (e.g. `cb:b038`, `agent-behavior:a054`), with exactly one owning collection per namespace, so ids are globally unique. Deps may cross namespaces and resolve globally, but `cb:` depends only within `cb:`; every other collection may depend on `cb:`. The separator is `:`.

evidence.detail: Extracted from the settled multi-repo restructure design (CB-RESTRUCTURE-HANDOFF.md §2.1); realized across the cb:/agent-behavior:/paradigm: graphs and the resolver/verifier in Stages 1-4.
